subject: Social Media
title: One-Hit Wonders
description: A micro-lesson that makes One-Hit Wonders usable.

hook.text: Psy's Gangnam Style hit two billion views. His next video? Nobody remembers. Virality rarely repeats.

buildup.text: Most viral creators never go viral again. The conditions are too chaotic to replicate reliably.

discovery.text: Researchers found that prior viral success doesn't predict future virality. Each hit is independent.

twist.text: One exception: accounts that build communities retain attention. Virality fades; loyalty stays.

climax.text: The smartest viral creators convert one-time viewers into subscribers. They trade fame for community.

punchline.text: Going viral is lightning. Community is electricity.

quiz.question: What typically happens to creators after one viral hit?
